candidates.title: FDE-Gym: The Last Mile of AI Delivery
candidates.summary: Benchmark of 95 end-to-end tasks testing agents on ambiguous requirements, live systems and unstated constraints, like forward-deployed engineers.

candidates.title: Player-1: Learning to Play from Synthetic Experience
candidates.summary: Computer-use agents learn to play games from synthetic experience instead of large human demonstration sets.

candidates.title: OpenGCUA: Toward a Fully Open Stack for Generalist Computer Use
candidates.summary: Fully open stack for agents that choose between visual and programmatic interfaces to finish computer tasks.

candidates.title: Self-Evolving Agent Harness
candidates.summary: Formalizes agents revising their own scaffolding (prompts, memory, workflows) with fixed weights.

candidates.title: Cortex: Consolidating Context into Parametric Memory
candidates.summary: Treats memory consolidation as internalizing context gains into weights while preserving other capabilities.

candidates.title: Waypoint-OPD: Transferring RL-Induced Policy Shifts via Gated On-Policy Distillation
candidates.summary: Distills the RL policy shift of a teacher along training waypoints, not just the endpoint.

candidates.title: More Methods, Better Agents? A Reality Check on Self-Distillation in Agentic RL
candidates.summary: Controlled comparison of contemporaneous self-distillation methods for agentic RL, covering stability and cost.

candidates.title: Agent-Reflex: Teaching Language Agents to Act Reflectively
candidates.summary: Trains agents to recover from noisy tool feedback and user corrections.

candidates.title: Jeva: System One Models from First Principles
candidates.summary: Argues decision-style models need null-aware, structured outputs; direct low-latency decisions.

candidates.title: Harness^2: Recursive Agent Harnessing for an Open World
candidates.summary: Recursive self-improvement of agent harnesses for unseen open-world tasks.
